concurrency_and_state: Player.tradeLock (ReentrantLock) exists in Player.java:86 but is never acquired in InventoryService (itemBagToBody, itemBodyToBag, itemBagToBox, itemBoxToBodyOrBag, throwItem) or ClanService.clanDonate, leaving bag/body/box mutations unprotected against concurrent packet races.

ClanService mutates and iterates Manager.CLANS (createClan, disbandClan, getClanById, getClans, close) and clan.members / clan.membersInGame without synchronization or thread-safe collections, risking ConcurrentModificationException and IndexOutOfBoundsException.

Player.temporaryEnemies, friends, enemies, Cards, itemsWoodChest, itemsTradeWVP are plain ArrayLists accessed across Netty I/O threads and Zone update loops; Player.update() allocates a new ArrayList<>(this.zone.items) every 2000ms for VeTinh range checks.

Player.injured() is synchronized on `this` (Player instance); Player.setDie() calls FriendAndEnemyService.addEnemy(this, plAtt) and BlackBallWarService/NgocRongNamecService drop methods while holding the Player monitor.
All service singletons (PetService, ClanService, FriendAndEnemyService, GiftService, IntrinsicService, InventoryService) use unsynchronized lazy initialization in gI().
cross_module_questions: Does TransactionService or Trade acquire player.getTradeLock() when reading/moving items, and how does it interact with InventoryService methods that only check player.isTrade without locking?

How does Client.gI().getPlayer(int) vs getPlayerByUser(int) behave for offline/online status in FriendAndEnemyService.openListFriend/openListEnemy and ClanService.acceptAskJoinClan (where NDVSqlFetcher.loadById(plxinvao) loads an offline Player and adds it to clan.membersInGame via addMemberOnline)?
Does the Unity client read -99 (enemy list) bag as short and power before online, matching FriendAndEnemyService.openListEnemy, vs -80 (friend list) where bag is byte and online is before power?
Are Clan.members / Clan.membersInGame CopyOnWriteArrayList or plain ArrayList in models/clan/Clan.java?

findings.impact: Concurrent inventory packets (equip, unequip, throw, box transfer, trade) can race and duplicate or destroy items despite player.isTrade checks.
findings.root_cause: InventoryService methods mutate itemsBag, itemsBody, and itemsBox without acquiring player.getTradeLock() or any synchronization lock; itemBagToBox checks player.isTrade before null-checking player (line 584 vs 588).
findings.title: Unlocked inventory mutations allow race-condition item dupe/loss

findings.impact: Two players can donate simultaneously on the same clan request exceeding maxDonate, or share the exact same mutable ItemOption list reference between giver's box stack and receiver's pea.
findings.root_cause: clanDonate has no synchronization on Clan/ClanMessage or giver's itemsBox, and line 190 assigns peaCopy.itemOptions = pea.itemOptions by reference instead of deep-copying.
findings.title: Clan pea donation race condition and shared ItemOption reference

findings.impact: Every call to isUsedGiftCode leaks a MySQL connection from HikariCP until pool exhaustion.
findings.root_cause: AlyraManager.getConnection().prepareStatement(query) only wraps PreparedStatement in try-with-resources, never closing the Connection.
findings.title: JDBC Connection leak in GiftService.isUsedGiftCode

findings.impact: Any client can send ACCEPT_JOIN_CLAN with an arbitrary clanId to join any clan without an invitation and bypass the leave-clan cooldown.
findings.root_cause: acceptJoinClan neither verifies a pending clan invitation nor returns when diff > 0 (lines 328-333 only send a notification and fall through into joining).
findings.title: Clan join authorization and cooldown bypass in ClanService.acceptJoinClan

findings.impact: Players wearing partial sets with an empty earlier slot (e.g. missing shirt slot 0) receive 0 set bonuses; items with SKT option + option 21 param 80 may skip setDHD counting.
findings.root_cause: setupSKT (line 140-142) and setupSKHNew (line 180-182) execute `break` instead of `continue` when an equipment slot is null; setupSKT also breaks early on `isActSet` before checking remaining options on the same item.
findings.title: SetClothes.setupSKT/setupSKHNew break on empty slot instead of continue

findings.impact: With >=2 stacks totaling >2.14B items (e.g., 2B thoi vang), countItemBag overflows int negative and removeItemQuantity refuses to deduct items.
findings.root_cause: countItemBag accumulates item.quantity into a 32-bit int even though addItemList allows stacks up to 2,000,000,000 (line 886).
findings.title: 32-bit int overflow in InventoryService.countItemBag

findings.impact: When chibi type 0 is active, picking up/receiving gold via addItemBag credits 2x gold and can exceed getGoldLimit(); items 925-931 gain duplicate 2-day expiry options on every addItemList call.
findings.root_cause: addGold is called twice when isChibi && typeChibi == 0 after checking limit only for 1x quantity; lines 852-854 unconditionally add Option(93, 2) without checking if option 93 is already present.
findings.title: Double gold credit bypassing limit and duplicate expiry options in InventoryService.addItemBag/addItemList

findings.impact: Possible NullPointerException in injured(), setDie(), kickOut(), sendMyClan(), and pet change methods; ConcurrentModificationException on Manager.CLANS.
findings.root_cause: Player.injured/setDie dereference this.zone.map without null checks; ClanService.kickOut calls clan.getClanMember before checking clan != null; ClanService.sendMyClan catch logs player.clan.name when player.clan may be null; PetService accesses player.pet without null check; Manager.CLANS is iterated/mutated unsynchronized.
findings.title: Missing null checks and unsynchronized Manager.CLANS access across Player/ClanService/PetService

findings.impact: Materials and gold are consumed while the cooked item is lost if bag is full; cooking both items simultaneously stalls the second timer.
findings.root_cause: finishCookingBanhDay/finishCookingBanhChung deduct items and gold without checking getCountEmptyBag > 0 or addItemBag return value; update() shares lastTimeUpdateCooking between both cooking timers.
findings.title: Shared cooking timer and item/gold loss when bag is full in Player cooking

findings.impact: Failed unequip when bag is full still deletes newPet and strips visual effects; cancelAskJoinClan displays leader's name instead of applicant's name; acceptAskJoinClan corrupts ClanMessage on early return; makeFriend advertises 5 gem fee without charging it.
findings.root_cause: Side effects (disposing newPet, removing player effect, mutating ClanMessage) execute before validating completion conditions; acceptMakeFriend omits gem deduction.
findings.title: Premature state mutation and missing fee deduction in Inventory/Clan/Friend services

findings.impact: PreparedStatement is not closed on exception and batch update failures are silently ignored; SuperRankDAO.updatePlayer blocks the Player.update() loop.
findings.root_cause: ClanService.close() omits PreparedStatement from try-with-resources and has an empty catch block; SuperRank.reward() runs synchronous JDBC inside Player.update().
findings.title: Resource/exception handling in ClanService.close and sync DB write in Player.update

findings.impact: High coupling and maintenance risk; Player.dispose() contains redundant field clearing statements.
findings.root_cause: Player acts as a God class (1476 lines) combining combat, cooking events, network session, and visual rendering; InventoryService (1256 lines) and ClanService (1208 lines) mix persistence, protocol, and business logic.
findings.title: God-class coupling in Player/InventoryService/ClanService and duplicate cleanup in Player.dispose

key_classes.responsibility: Calculates equipped set bonuses (SKT, new SKH, God, Destroyer, HaiTac) from player body slots 0-5.

key_classes.name: RewardBlackBall
key_classes.responsibility: Tracks Black Ball War buff expiration timestamps and rewards per star (1-7).

key_classes.responsibility: Manages friend/enemy lists, private chat, enemy revenge selection, and Yardrat teleportation to players.

key_classes.name: InventoryService
key_classes.responsibility: Manages bag/body/box/pet item storage, equip/unequip/drop/stacking rules, inventory queries, and client sync packets.

module_summary: Deep-read of batch server_player_combat__p02 (19 files, 5882 lines) covering core Player entity, player state components (SetClothes, RewardBlackBall, SuperRank, PlayerEffect, Satellite, Traning), radar cards, skills (NClass, PlayerSkill, Skill), and player/pet/clan/inventory/social/gift/intrinsic services. Identified critical anti-dupe locking gaps in InventoryService and ClanService, a HikariCP connection leak in GiftService, authorization/cooldown bypasses in ClanService, set-bonus skipping in SetClothes, int overflow in InventoryService.countItemBag, and several null-safety and concurrency issues.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Sends KSkill (10 bytes), OSkill (10 bytes), and CSkill (1 byte skillTemplate.id) skill shortcut configuration.

protocol_touchpoints.opcode: Clan handlers (getClan, clanMessage, clanDonate, joinClan, clanRemote, clanInvite)
protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Reads action/type bytes, playerId/clanId/clanMessageId ints, imgId byte, and name/slogan/text UTF strings.
-57 clan invite, -47 clan search list, -50 clan member list, -53 full my-clan info & messages, -61 broadcast clanId to map.
Reads action byte, target playerId int, and private chat UTF text.
-80 friend list (sub 0) / remove friend (sub 2); -99 enemy list (sub 0). Note bag is byte in -80 vs short in -99, and power/online field order differs.
Sub 0 sends current intrinsic icon+name; Sub 1 sends tab count, tab title, and list of intrinsic icons+descriptions.
-36 bag items, -37 body items + head, -35 box items (sub 0) and open box (sub 1). Option id written as byte, param as short.
